Package logic

Class ParkSettingsRequest

java.lang.Object
logic.ParkSettingsRequest
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ParkSettingsRequest extends Object implements Serializable
represents one row in the park_settings_requests table. used both as the payload for SUBMIT_PARK_SETTINGS (from park manager to server) and as a read-only row in the department manager's Pending Approvals panel.
